promise: Predict that AI models might perform most or all software-engineering work end to end within six to twelve months
description: In the Davos 2026 discussion, Amodei offered a conditional six-to-twelve-month estimate for AI to perform most or all software-engineering work end to end. He did not define completion as eliminating software-engineering jobs.
evidence: Prediction made January 2026 with a 6-12 month window
No large-scale replacement of software engineers reported as of August 2026

review.note: Transcript verifies conditional six-to-twelve-month capability forecast, not replacement of every engineer. Employment displacement is not a valid outcome measure for the claim. Exact session date and January 31 cutoff require confirmation; a twelve-month window is not automatically month-end.

sources.name: World Economic Forum: Davos interview transcript
